body: Create a single-frame stop-motion-style scene featuring {{character}}. Build everything from colored modeling clay, including tiny props and a simple handmade set. Show subtle fingerprints, tool marks and imperfect paint that make the objects feel physical. Give the character a readable expression and pose. Use soft practical lighting and a gently blurred pastel backdrop.
